messages:
lina_sales: Hey team — need quick approval for a startup POC offer for ClearHarbor. They requested a 3mo trial + promotional credits and want dedicated capacity for the eval. Can we sign off on credits + special terms so we can kick the POC this week?

lina_sales: Proposed: 3 months trial window, $15,000 platform credit applied to usage, no upfront monetary charge, POC on 2x A10 GPUs for 4 weeks, optional reserved commit if they convert within 90 days. No changes to standard SLA.

lina_sales: Key ask: waive first-month usage for the POC (credit covers it), and allow a 30% convert discount on dedicated pricing if they commit annual after POC.

matt_dealdesk: pinging @deal-desk-bot and @emma_finance. Quick Qs: is $15k within promo allowance or needs manager approval? Also need to see ARR signal if we convert — any forecast?

lina_sales: They projected ~$120k ARR first year if pilot goes well. The buyer is a seed-stage infra startup, fundraising in progress. No legal red flags yet; they've asked for SSO and SOC2 details.

emma_finance: Accounting note: promotional credits must be coded as marketing expense unless there's a commit. $15k is above our auto-approve threshold. I'll need budget signoff or deal-desk manager approval.

deal-desk-bot: AUTO-REPLY: Promo credit limit per rep = $5,000. Requests > $5,000 require manager approval and a short justification. Please attach forecast and security checklist.

matt_dealdesk: OK — Lina, can you reduce to $5k auto-approve + manager review for the incremental $10k? Or switch the extra $10k to a time-limited convert credit (applies only if they sign annual within 90d)? That reduces spend risk.

lina_sales: We can do $5k up-front and $10k as convert-credit (only redeemable if they sign a 12mo reserved commit within 90 days). That keeps finance happy.

ash_security: Heads-up: if POC uses dedicated capacity, we need a short contract addendum for data isolation & ephemeral VM controls. Also require completed security questionnaire and SSO config before granting access.

liz_sales_eng: I can run the POC on our side. Need 2 x A10 for 4 weeks, and access to their sample prompts and data. I'll prepare a minimal eval runbook.

emma_finance: With that structure ($5k promo + $10k contingent convert-credit) I can approve pending manager sign-off. Please add a note that convert-credit expires after 90 days and is non-transferable. Also need GL code: PMT_PROMO_2026.

matt_dealdesk: Manager @maria_dd, can you approve the extra $10k contingent credit? Rationale: high conversion probability (seed infra co, $120k ARR forecast). Standard T&Cs apply.

maria_dd: Approving the $10k contingent credit on the terms listed (redeemable only on 12mo reserved commit within 90 days, expires if not used). Require completed security questionnaire + signature on POC addendum.

lina_sales: Thanks @maria_dd! I'll send the POC addendum + questionnaire link to ClearHarbor now. Also noting GL code and convert-credit expiry in the SOW.

sophie_support: For onboarding: please add a note to Support that this is a POC with dedicated infra and convert-credit attached. We need escalations enabled and a contact.

lina_sales: Will do. Final checklist for handoff: 1) security questionnaire filled, 2) SSO setup, 3) POC addendum signed, 4) credits applied ($5k now, $10k contingent), 5) liz to schedule GPUs.

liz_sales_eng: Scheduling GPUs once we have signed addendum. ETA: start next Tuesday if all done today.

matt_dealdesk: Updating deal desk record: promo_#CH-2026-01, approved by maria_dd, finance code PMT_PROMO_2026. Leaving a note: contingent credit requires contract amendment on conversion.

lina_sales: Great — thanks everyone :party_parrot: I'll post the signed docs here when complete and loop in legal if anything unusual pops up.

ash_security: I'll review questionnaire once returned. If anything pops, ping me.

maria_dd: Approved in thread. Keep docs attached in this thread for audit.

lina_sales: Will do. Closing for now — I'll update later with signed addendum and questionnaire. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
